q: wifi wont connect on my new camra, setup says network not suported
answer:
To resolve the "Network not supported" error during setup:

1. In your router settings, create a separate 2.4 GHz SSID or temporarily disable the 5 GHz radio (NovaTech devices cannot join 5 GHz). [03_wifi_5ghz_band_issues.txt]
2. Connect your phone to the 2.4 GHz network. [03_wifi_5ghz_band_issues.txt]
3. Restart pairing. [03_wifi_5ghz_band_issues.txt]
4. After successful setup, you can re-enable 5 GHz. [03_wifi_5ghz_band_issues.txt]

q: My hub shows Error H201, what should I do?
answer:
To resolve Error H201 (Hub Offline), follow these quick checks:

1. Confirm other devices have internet [04_hub_offline_troubleshooting.txt].
2. Power-cycle the hub by unplugging it for 30 seconds [04_hub_offline_troubleshooting.txt].
3. Power-cycle the router [04_hub_offline_troubleshooting.txt].

If you are still offline, you can also connect the hub to the router using an Ethernet cable, as the hub automatically prefers a wired connection [04_hub_offline_troubleshooting.txt]. Additionally, check whether the router has MAC filtering or a firewall blocking outbound ports 443 and 8883 [04_hub_offline_troubleshooting.txt]. If it remains unresolved after 15 minutes, perform a hub factory reset [04_hub_offline_troubleshooting.txt].

q: How do I factory reset the NovaHub?
answer:
To factory reset the NovaHub, follow these steps:

1. Locate the recessed Reset button on the back of the hub [05_hub_factory_reset.txt].
2. With the hub powered on, hold the button with a paper clip for 10 seconds until the LED flashes red three times [05_hub_factory_reset.txt].
3. Release the button; the hub will restart and pulse white [05_hub_factory_reset.txt].

q: My smart lock battery died and I am locked out, what can I do?

2. Use the backup physical key supplied with every lock [03_lock_battery_and_power.txt].
